title: Beyond satisfied and would 100% recommend.
text:
Beyond satisfied and would 100% recommend.. This is my first ever fake tree. All my life I have refused a fake tree, I've always insisted on a real one and I got one this year, only this tree HAD WORMS IN IT!! I was so disgusted at what I saw I wanted to throw up! So I decided to get a fake one because I never want to chance a tree filled with worms ever again so I reluctantly started shopping for fake tree. All so expensive and I didnt want to choose somthing that would disappoint or look too fake.
After looking at a ton of trees I found this one and liked the review pictures so took the plunge.
So happy with this tree!!! Exceeded my expectations and looks beautiful, full, and with no big gaps. The flocking is great at giving it that more realistic look by hiding the cheaper needles. The branches are also plenty sturdy for my heavier ornaments too and I LOVE how I can bend the tip of the branch to keep my most cherished ornaments from falling!
100% reccomend.
